subject: D-INTEG-01 dest-integrity observables
body:
TASK: D-INTEG-01 observables
STATUS: CANDIDATE. Not BOARD_PASS. PROGRAM=NO.

FEM dest-integrity observable: dest_committed_corrupt (COMMIT magic AND dest CRC invalid).
ASTRA mapping remains B-owned: DATA_INTEGRITY_FAIL 0x06 + COMMITTED_CORRUPT 0x56. Never status 0x56. Never UNKNOWN. Never install as COMMITTED_NEW.
recover_state stays {0 OLD_VALID, 1 CANDIDATE_NEW, 2 COMMITTED_NEW}. D does not emit recover_state=3.

Directory out_of_profile (id > active_id_max) is admit-fail, not an ASTRA status.
k_invalid: D does not invent a new meaning. C must expose k_invalid; B maps 0x06+0x23. astra_adv_dut q_ready/s_ready still 0 (fail-closed). Reward Gate remains outside Q*; D has not wired episode/step/command/generation into a gate module this slice.

M2_POST_XSIM_PASS rows=235 is simulation only, not M2_PASS.
